notes.title: Update Alert!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Guys![/h1]

We've been listening to your feedback and working hard to further improve your experience with our game. We’re excited to share with you a few updates and changes!

[b]Achievements have landed![/b]
To unlock them one needs to play the game again. We’ve prepared some hidden achievements on your way through, so we didn’t want to spoil the fun.

We also have another big surprise for you, as [b]AoF will be participating in the Weeklong sale[/b] starting from Monday, 24th of April. So for those of you who are still considering discovering the story behind Nate’s disappearance - here’s your chance (:

We are still focusing our efforts on further improving your experience with our game.

Lastly, we'd like to extend our thanks to all of you who have played Anthology of Fear and supported us through this journey. We couldn't have come this far without your feedback.


[h3]See you soon,
OhDeer Studio and 100 GAMES[/h3]

notes.title: Regarding the feedback and first fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Hi again![/h2]

It’s been an intense weekend! We want to thank everyone who gave Anthology of Fear a chance. Your positive opinions warmed our hearts though we appreciate and are grateful for the constructive feedback which enables continuous improvement of the overall experience. We have told this story the way we wanted to, although there are still some parts we are still implementing. We will be addressing the below as quickly as we can.

We’re prioritizing the major issues raised. Firstly, the price. We’ve heard your feedback about price/playtime ratio and we will be adding additional content to the game.

A thing which concerned many of you was the interaction system. There will soon be an option to switch between simplified and original interaction mode. Now it will be the left mouse button.

When it comes to the save system, we are working on adding the option to load the unlocked chapters.

A patch regarding those issues – as well as some minor fixes – will be uploaded near the end of this week. We hope those changes will make your experience with AoF even more pleasant.

Lastly - as it comes to the ending: Ethan’s story has indeed ended, and we finished it the way we intended this story to unfold. However, there will be an opportunity to experience more tapes from the Morpheus Medical Center in the near future. 

In a couple of days we will also add achievements to the game, and we are also planning some extras.  

[h3]Stay tuned![/h3]
[h2]OhDeer Studio and 100 Games team.
[/h2]

notes.title: Launch, price, technicalities
notes.content:
The story we've planted in our demo is about to reveal. To say that our team is excited would be an awful understatement (; 

[h3]The game is out now! Limited time launch discount of -30%. The discount will last for a week.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092530/Anthology_of_Fear/

[b]You can also try your luck in giveaways organized by your favorite YouTubers! [/b]

It’s been an interesting couple of weeks and we’re not slowing down yet, there’s still so much to be done. If this were the perfect world, then everything would be ready weeks before the launch, but it’s not the perfect world and it never goes that way (;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401933/565e800964044413da9ab591cf0ec4535313ca1a.png[/img]

That being said, if you encounter any major bugs, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on Steam discussions. We’ve added a subforum just for bug reporting, there’s also a brief guide provided to help you (and us) with eliminating all the issues.

Moreover, [b]all 15 languages have been implemented. Full controller support has also been added [/b]. Steam Deck compatibility is entirely on Valve's side to make such verification. We are optimistic that they will conduct it shortly. Achievements will be added in the first few patches. 

We hope you will have fun facing the horrors of our humble creation,
[h2]OhDeer Studio and 100 Games team[/h2]

notes.title: We'd like to ask you something...
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2]

We are excited to say that the main bulk of the work on Anthology of Fear is done! There’s no time to rest yet, though, as we keep on polishing the experience and working on as many details we can. We’re doing what we can so you can have the best experience playing Anthology on release day.

When it comes to translations we mentioned in the last devlog, we are happy to confirm the complete list of languages in the full version of AoF:

English, Polish, German, Italian, Chinese Traditional
Chinese Simplified, Spanish-Latin America, French, Korean, Ukrainian
Japanese, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese-Brazil, Czech

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401933/02fc9d9bff3b5fdeb2a8725ff6be4f5ddc772749.png[/img]

Additionally, we started adding more graphical settings, which now include:
- Gamma & Brightness
- Motion blur
- Depth of field
- Chromatic Aberration
- Film grain

However, we ask for a small favor: [u]please let us know if there are other settings you would like to see in the game. [/u]
We are still working on improving accessibility in AoF, and if we could help you enjoy the game a little bit more by adding some options, we will happily do it.

[h2]See you soon,
OhDeer Studio and 100 Games team[/h2]

notes.title: New translations!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi again![/h2]

Happy new year! May it be full of joy and thrilling experiences. We know we’re a bit late, but we come to you with great news!

Thanks to our friends over at gamersky com, with the newest update we’re adding Simplified and Traditional Chinese translations. Our team has also put together a Polish translation. We hope this will help make [i]Anthology of Fear[/i] available to a larger audience.

At this moment, we do not plan on adding additional translations to the demo; however, the full version of the game will include around 15 languages (which we will update on the game's store page soon).

[h2]See you soon,
OhDeer Studio and 100 Games team
[/h2]

notes.title: Anthology of Fear on Scream Fest 2022!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2]

	Let’s celebrate the spooky season together, during this year’s Scream Fest. We are proud to have our demo displayed among other great horror titles and happy to see fellow indie developers sharing their progress.

 	We’ve been working hard on AoF since the Next Fest. It’s great to see more and more people recording their playthroughs, many of whom found us on itch.io. We want you to know that we’re listening and appreciating your guys’ feedback and we will be updating the demo as we work on the full version of the game. There are a few major updates coming your way, but for the Halloween event we focused on fixing more urgent issues to make the demo more enjoyable. Those include:

[list]
[*] Fixing triggers on doors
[*] Increasing the range of gamma slider
[*] Minor fixes for guiding players through the map
[*] Adding a few new interactions and events on the level
[*] Fixing cutscene audio levels
[*] Optimizing interaction with doors
[*] Updating HDRP to optimize the game
[/list]

There are some minor known issues, though:
[list]
[*] Updating HDRP glitched reflections and textures on a few meshes
[*] The game can freeze for a second when loading new events
[*] The clothes are not yet perfectly fitted to certain… characters
[/list]

	To celebrate the Halloween event we have also modified the scenes just a little bit; the changes are not in the game yet, but they will be added in tomorrow’s update! It’s only cosmetic, but we wanted to add some spooky vibes to the environment. 

	As always, we welcome your feedback. The release date is coming quickly, and our team is quite small, but we will do what we can to make the game more fun to play.

[h1]Have fun during this Halloween![/h1]
